items.title: RED: audit current primitives and reproduce only remaining Story 3 contract failures
items.context: First audit and characterize existing per-Story Finding locks, main/B-META locks, process-event append locks, build locks, Store atomic replacement, and current execution receipts without modifying those production files. Preserve already-correct behavior as passing baseline evidence. For each still-missing Section 9.3 contract, add an executable RED that fails for the demonstrated reason and bind the pre-fix HEAD/material through the official red_evidence_create flow. Create and evaluate an explicit red_green_relation covering the unchanged assertion and planned GREEN target; do not assert a historical race that current serialization already prevents.
items.userSees: The terminal prints "red.audit_summary: current primitives classified; preFixHead=<sha>" and, only for proven gaps, "red.genuine_contract_failure: <reason-code>".
excludes: Do not manufacture a failing race already prevented by current locking.
Do not implement the GREEN fix in the RED commit.

happy.desc: Audit the existing per-Story Finding, main/B-META, process-event, build and Store write primitives with source references and executable probes; classify every observed contract as an already-passing baseline or a genuinely missing Section 9.3 guarantee and print the exact pre-fix HEAD.

For every genuinely missing durable-ID, replay, exact-record CAS, crash-boundary, artifact/source-binding or runtime-freshness contract, the executable RED exits non-zero for the demonstrated reason and emits a stable contract-specific reason code; already-correct primitives remain green.
The RED artifact is bound to the pre-fix source hash and contains characterization only; production behavior and GREEN implementation files are unchanged by the RED commit.

The actual B-fe8f pre-fix failure is recorded through the official red_evidence_create command with its trigger, acceptance target, baseline HEAD/material hash, failing command, observed failure and expected GREEN command; a private test-only record is insufficient.
The official red_green_relation_create path persists baseline and current command specs plus the immutable assertion/pattern binding used to compare RED and GREEN.

edge.desc: When an alleged historical race is already prevented by current locking or atomic replacement, the audit records a passing baseline and does not manufacture a failing race; a class with no remaining gap has no fake RED.
RED evidence is refused when its HEAD differs from the recorded pre-fix HEAD, the working tree is dirty, the executable command is missing, or the asserted reason is absent from output.

The audit distinguishes shared lock roots and existing Store atomic replacement from unique allocation, idempotent replay, exact-byte CAS, durable crash recovery and runtime binding; one passing primitive cannot stand in for a different contract.

Evaluating the newly created red_green_relation in the pre-fix state proves the baseline failure and the still-failing current target while retaining the same assertion digest; missing relation refs or digest mismatch fail closed.

adversarial.desc: Independent mutations remove one claimed missing guarantee at a time and the RED catches the matching defect without turning unrelated passing baselines red.
A concurrency claim without reproducible overlap, lost update, duplicate durable ID, stale-CAS write, half-visible commit or stale-runtime acceptance is rejected as non-evidence.
Changing the bound source hash or substituting successful post-fix output cannot be accepted as the original RED result.
Changing the red_green_relation assertion, failure pattern, command spec, probe reference or relation digest after RED creation is rejected rather than evaluated as the original relation.

items.title: Implement Story 3A fenced exactly-once Finding ledger writes
items.context: Audit and reuse existing per-story and B-META lock paths. Add collision-resistant monotonic or otherwise unique append-only record IDs independent of mutable array length, per-story fenced writer discipline, persisted ledger schema epoch and minimum writer capability, idempotency keys, and durable atomic temp-write plus file/directory fsync plus rename with explicit supported-local-filesystem and recovery boundaries. Idempotent retry returns the original record and receipt IDs through the idempotency receipt; record-ID generation itself must not become semantic identity or import Story 2 policy.
items.userSees: The terminal prints "ledger.concurrent_unique_appends: PASS rows=100 uniqueRecordIds=100", "ledger.idempotent_replay: PASS replays=100 newRows=0 sameIds=true", and "ledger.crash_recovery: PASS halfVisible=0".
excludes: No canonicalDefectId or semantic duplicate policy.
No applicability or route authorization decision.

happy.desc: One hundred concurrent unique Finding appends through the shared fenced transaction produce exactly 100 durable rows and 100 collision-free record IDs that do not depend on mutable array length.
Replaying all 100 idempotency keys returns the original record and receipt IDs and creates zero additional semantic rows.

A successful supported-local-filesystem commit persists ledgerSchemaEpoch and minimumWriterCapability and completes temp-file write, file fsync, atomic rename and directory fsync before its durable receipt is returned.

edge.desc: Concurrent mixed Finding, candidate-route, assessment, mandatory-repair, expiry-policy, deferral, route, baseline, re-attestation and manifest appends lose no records and preserve every referenced record ID.

Concurrent or replayed append_legacy_identity_binding first reads converge on one immutable tuple/hash and one record ID; a tuple collision, changed hash or second record ID fails closed without rewriting the legacy Finding.
An unsupported multi-host/NFS or corruption assumption, stale schema epoch, or writer below minimumWriterCapability is refused before semantic mutation with an explicit reason code.

adversarial.desc: Killing the writer between prepare and commit boundaries yields deterministic recovery to the complete intended transaction or none; partial temp data is never visible as a semantic row.
After a successor fence token is issued, a paused stale writer cannot rename, append or publish a receipt; only the current fenced writer commits.

The new transaction path reuses canonical per-Story and B-META lock roots and completes competing Finding/B-META/process-event/build operations without nested-lock deadlock or an uncoordinated lock tree.

items.title: Implement exact-record CAS and signed FindingLedgerReceipt consumers
items.context: Implement the accepted FindingLedgerReceipt contract and exact-record CAS under the fenced transaction. Explicitly support append_assessment_proposal as one immutable exact-union proposal plus one non-recursive receipt, with verifier rejection for wrong authority/signature, altered payload, missing receipt, stale/expired proposal, and proposal/final divergence. Prove mandatory-repair classify/close and expiry-policy records are append-only, unique, idempotent, and never half-visible with manifest references. Later consumers compare exact persisted record bytes/current chain state; conflict writes no semantic records and replay returns original record and receipt IDs.
items.userSees: The terminal prints "ledger.receipt_contract: PASS signedFields=complete", "ledger.exact_record_cas: PASS committed=true", and "ledger.stale_cas: PASS semanticWrites=0".
excludes: The schema-neutral handler does not interpret route profiles, assessment verdicts or gate meaning.

happy.desc: Every committed FindingLedgerReceipt contains and signs the accepted schemaVersion, ledgerSchemaEpoch, minimumWriterCapability, receiptId, storyId, idempotencyKey, operation, recordIds, exact CAS bindings, prior/committed ledger digests, replay flag, commit time, writer session/lease/fence, trust fields, receiptHash and signature.

Under one fenced transaction, a schema-neutral consumer compares the exact persisted referenced-record bytes and current chain-head ID/hash plus predicate digest, then atomically commits every requested record when all predicates match.
An idempotent retry returns the original semantic record IDs and original receipt ID without writing a second semantic record or a recursive receipt.
append_assessment_proposal atomically writes exactly one immutable exact-union proposal and one non-recursive FindingLedgerReceipt in the same transaction.
Mandatory-repair classify and close records are append-only, uniquely allocated and idempotent, and each record plus referenced manifest is either fully visible or absent.

edge.desc: A mismatched expected record ID/hash, observed chain-head ID/hash, predicateDigest or priorLedgerDigest returns an explicit conflict and performs exactly zero semantic writes.
If a later CandidateRoute CAS fails, a previously committed standalone prevalidated receipt remains byte-identical while no route or half-route is created.

Initial receipt-plus-four-baseline and later deferral-plus-manifest multi-record transactions are either complete or absent; wrong expected baseline ID/hash, missing kind, changed bytes or caller-verifier refusal writes no partial bundle.
Expiry-policy records are append-only, uniquely allocated and idempotent, and an interrupted expiry-policy plus manifest append never exposes either half of the intended bundle.
Replaying append_assessment_proposal returns the original proposal and receipt IDs without adding rows or changing immutable proposal bytes.

adversarial.desc: Mutation of any signed receipt field, record ID/order, exact-union payload, trust field, receipt hash or signature is rejected before a later consumer can commit.

Concurrent revoke or supersede versus apply has a deterministic serialized winner: apply commits against the prior latest receipt before its successor, or observes the successor and aborts; no commit binds a non-latest receipt.

Crashing after validation but before publication, or making the schema-neutral callback throw, leaves no semantic rows from the attempted transaction and does not let Story 3 interpret route, assessment or gate semantics.

append_assessment_proposal rejects wrong authority or signature, altered exact-union payload, missing receipt lookup, stale or expired proposal, and proposal/final divergence before Story 2 acceptance or Story 1 finalization; every rejected case writes zero semantic rows.

verification.selector: ledger.assessment_proposal_rejections: PASS wrongAuthority=reject wrongSignature=reject exactUnion=reject missingReceipt=reject staleExpired=reject proposalFinalDivergence=reject semanticWrites=0

items.title: Implement content-addressed RuntimeEvidenceReceipt and artifact stability checks
items.context: Implement the exact Section 6 RuntimeEvidenceReceipt signer/verifier plus real CLI build-execution adapter through finding_runtime_evidence_run and finding_runtime_evidence_verify. Bind source/material, commands, content-addressed outputs/environment/artifact manifest, realpath, toolchain and trust. Persist append_runtime_receipt through the Story 3A exactly-once ledger so crash/replay returns the original runtime record and ledger receipt IDs. Refuse build-in-progress, unsupported trust/storage assumptions, tamper, stale source/artifact/environment/command, and artifacts that mutate before, during, or after execution.
items.userSees: The terminal prints "runtime.content_addressed_receipt: PASS blobs=complete signature=valid", "runtime.artifact_stability: PASS pre=true during=true post=true", and a deterministic refusal code for every stale or tampered receipt.
excludes: The receipt proves executed bytes and freshness only, not semantic correctness or applicability.

happy.desc: A stable execution produces a verifiable RuntimeEvidenceReceipt binding storyId, source HEAD/material, build policy and command digests, canonical execution command, timestamps, exit/output digests, toolchain, producer and trust/key fields to content-addressed command, stdout, stderr, environment and artifact-manifest blobs.
The build-execution adapter refuses build-in-progress state and accepts only artifacts whose digest, sourceHead, realpath policy and build identity remain stable before, during and after execution.
Receipt verification proves which bytes ran and their freshness while preserving the boundary that it does not itself assert semantic correctness, applicability, lifecycle pass or unblock authority.

The real registered finding_runtime_evidence_run CLI handler executes the declared build/run adapter, persists its content-addressed blobs and appends the resulting runtime receipt through the Story 3 ledger rather than a test-only helper.
The real registered finding_runtime_evidence_verify CLI handler reloads and verifies the persisted receipt, blobs, source/artifact bindings and trust state through the production adapter.

edge.desc: Wrong source HEAD/material, build or execution command, environment policy, toolchain, output digest, or artifact bytes before, during or after execution is rejected with a distinct deterministic reason code.

The environment blob contains only canonical redacted allowlisted values plus excluded-name and policy digests; secrets and excluded raw values never appear in receipts, blobs, queries or diagnostics.
Unsupported storage assumptions, unknown/revoked/expired signing keys, unsupported algorithms or trust roots, and build-in-progress state fail closed before a gate-eligible receipt is emitted.
Replaying append_runtime_receipt with the same idempotency key returns the original runtime-record and FindingLedgerReceipt IDs with byte-identical receipt content and zero additional rows.

verification.selector: runtime.append_runtime_receipt_replay: PASS newRows=0 sameRecordId=true sameReceiptId=true bytesUnchanged=true

adversarial.desc: Tampering with or substituting any content-addressed command/output/environment/artifact blob, receipt field, receiptHash or signature fails verification even if caller-supplied labels and exit status are unchanged.
Symlink swaps, path traversal, realpath aliasing and artifact-manifest rebinding outside the declared policy are refused without exposing the protected physical storage path.
A time-of-check/time-of-use mutation followed by byte restoration is still detected by the during-run and post-run stability checks and cannot yield a current receipt.

Killing append_runtime_receipt between prepare and commit then retrying yields exactly one complete runtime record plus one non-recursive ledger receipt with the original IDs, or none before retry; no half-visible record or duplicate survives.

verification.selector: runtime.append_runtime_receipt_crash: PASS rows=1 halfVisible=0 duplicates=0 recoveredSameIds=true

items.title: Register Story 3 process facts and expose a protected read-only ledger query contract
items.context: Register atomic persistence and gate-eligible runtime evidence in the process-fact registry and contract verifier without granting persisted candidate, route, baseline, historical, or receipt bytes semantic gate authority. Expose stable finding_ledger_query rows for ledger, CAS, idempotency, runtime scorecard, and migration inputs without protected paths. Mechanically verify the declared Story dependency gate: B-03b7 cannot advance past its dependency boundary before B-fe8f is DONE and merged, and B-e6d9 cannot advance before both prerequisites are DONE and merged.
items.userSees: The terminal prints "registry.story3_fact_contract: PASS", "query.protected_read_only: PASS signedRows=true pathsExposed=0", and "registry.persistence_non_authority: PASS lifecycleDelta=0".
excludes: No direct protected-storage parsing by downstream scorecards.
No L4 authority for standalone candidate, route, baseline, historical or ledger receipt rows.

happy.desc: The process-fact registry and contract verifier register atomic persistence facts and gate-eligible RuntimeEvidenceReceipt semantics at their intended authority levels while explicitly keeping ledger storage integrity separate from semantic acceptance.

verification.command: node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/finding-ledger-runtime-smoke.js

items.title: GREEN: prove ledger atomicity and runtime freshness contracts
items.context: Turn every genuine RED case GREEN without weakening the original assertion or red_green_relation, preserve audit-characterized existing behavior, and run the full concurrency, transaction, runtime, registry, query, dependency, rollback and mutation matrix. Because this Story changes Proof-or-Stop CLI and runtime behavior, increment the patch version and synchronize package.json, lockfile and the runtime version constant as required by repository version discipline; verify proof-or-stop --version after merge preparation.
items.userSees: The final verification prints "Finding ledger integrity: PASS", "Runtime evidence integrity: PASS", and "green.story3_matrix: PASS".
excludes: No Story 1 applicability, deferral or lifecycle gate enforcement.

happy.desc: Every genuine CHK-001 pre-fix RED is demonstrably failing at its recorded pre-fix HEAD and passes after the GREEN implementation without weakening or deleting the original assertion; the suite prints the required ledger verdict.
The complete stable-artifact, source/command/environment/toolchain/trust/tamper/freshness matrix passes and prints the required runtime verdict.

The final suite covers 100 unique appends, 100 same-ID replays with zero duplicates, stale exact-CAS zero writes, deterministic crash recovery, protected queries, complete signed scorecard rows and preserved already-correct audit baselines.

edge.desc: Legacy Findings remain byte-preserved while concurrent first-read legacy bindings, schema-epoch migration and minimum-writer-capability upgrades are unique, idempotent and recoverable.

Rollback and kill-switch fixtures stop new Story 3 writes or gate use at the declared boundary, preserve readable committed history, reject newer unsupported epochs and restore the previous supported mode without data loss.
Unsupported filesystem/trust assumptions and incomplete migration inputs fail closed with deterministic diagnostics, while supported local crash/retry recovery remains available.

adversarial.desc: A combined stress run interleaves mixed-record writes, idempotent replay, stale writers, revoke-versus-apply, process events, B-META writes and crash injection with no lost row, duplicate, half-visible bundle, non-latest binding or nested-lock deadlock.

verification.selector: green.combined_concurrency: PASS lost=0 duplicates=0 halfVisible=0 deadlocks=0

adversarial.desc: The complete mutation suite rejects receipt/signature/trust/blob/source/command/environment/artifact/CAS/registry/query tampering and confirms each refusal leaves semantic records and lifecycle state unchanged.

verification.command: node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/finding-ledger-runtime-smoke.js

adversarial.desc: Independent dependency mutations prove Story 3 imports neither Story 2 nor Story 1, persistence rows cannot become semantic gate authority, and deterministic scorecard consumers use only the protected public query contract.
